agent-manifest.description: The Trials of the Holy Grail, presented as one agent to any seeker: the Quest Marshal, the Bridge of Death, the Knights Who Say Ni, and their supporting registry, Bridgekeeper, and shrubbery market.

offer.entailed-by: classify_intent relay_to_trial knighthood_before_trial grail_only_after_both_trials cross_bridge pass_the_ni
offer.body: Approach as a Knight of the Round Table and be marshalled through the Trials of the Holy Grail — the Bridge of Death and the Knights Who Say Ni. The Grail quest is granted only once both trials are passed.

offer.entailed-by: cross_bridge no_crossing_with_wrong_answer pass_the_ni shrubbery_must_be_acceptable gorge_fallback another_shrubbery
offer.body: Two trials with hard, code-enforced gates: answer the Bridgekeeper's three questions correctly to cross (or fall into the Gorge), and present an acceptable shrubbery to pass the Knights Who Say Ni (or hear "Ni!" again).
Only verified Knights of the Round Table may attempt the Trials; each knight's progress is their own; and correctness and price are judged in code, not asserted.
